description: This file defines a pipeline behavior class for handling database transactions within the Conduit project. It uses MediatR to intercept requests and manage transaction scope, committing or rolling back the transaction based on success or failure.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A pipeline behavior that manages database transactions for request processing, ensuring that transactions are committed on success and rolled back on exception.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Intercepts a request, begins a transaction, executes the next delegate, commits if successful, or rolls back in case of an exception.
